name: Staff of Waves (Far Distant Future Publishing)
body:
Aura strong varied; CL 13th; Slot none; Price 197,600 gp; Weight 5 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This mother of pearl staff is carved from the shell of a giant clam shell. Its opalescent design holds the following powers:

Water breathing (1 charge)
Create water (1 charge)
Ray of frost (1 charge)
Lightning bolt (1 charge)
Fog cloud (1 charge)
Control water (2 charges)
Freedom of movement (2 charges)
Cure serious wounds (2 charges)
Gust of wind (2 charges)
Summon elemental (medium water elemental) (3 charges)
Control weather (4 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Staff; Spells create water, ray of frost, lightning bolt, fog cloud, control water, freedom of movement, cure serious wounds, gust of wind, summon elemental IV, control weather; Cost 98,800 gp.
